meta.name: CineStill 800T
notes: CineStill publishes no technical data. CineStill 800T is reported to be Kodak Vision3 500T (5219) with its rem-jet anti-halation backing removed, rated at EI 800 and processed in C-41; this look is the 5219 datasheet curves rated at EI 800 and printed on a colour paper.
The red glow around highlights (halation) is modelled; its radius, threshold and strength are Grainy's choice, not published values.
